subject: [PATCH v2 2/2] btrfs: introduce more accurate usebackuproot options

reviews.author: Boris Burkov
reviews.summary: Raised concerns about complexity of mirroring compression levels and suggested a simpler approach with 4 options. Approved the current implementation as easier to implement.

2026-09-30.patch_summary: Proposal to introduce more accurate usebackuproot options in Btrfs, including mirroring compression levels and parsing as rescue=usebackuproot[:N]

reviews.author: Qu Wenruo
reviews.summary: Responded to Boris' concerns by explaining that the current implementation is simpler and easier to maintain. Provided a brief explanation of why mirroring compression levels was not pursued.
reviews.raw_body:
在 2026/10/1 03:53, Boris Burkov 写道:
> On Sun, Sep 06, 2026 at 04:33:38PM +0930, Qu Wenruo wrote:
>> Previously we had no way to tell btrfs to use which backup slot, but
>> always use the newest backup, and retry until all backup roots are
>> exhausted.
>>
>> This doesn't give any control to the end user, even if the end user
>> wants to use a specific backup slot.
>>
>> To address this problem, allow more fine-control on usebackuproot rescue
>> option by introducing the following 4 rescue mount options:
>>
>> - rescue=usebackuproot_0
>> - rescue=usebackuproot_1
>> - rescue=usebackuproot_2
>> - rescue=usebackuproot_3
> 
> What do you think about mirroring the compression levels and having the
> option parse as rescue=usebackuproot[:N] rather than 4 options?

That's the solution I tried before, it turns out it's more complex to 
get all the parsing and validation done.

Meanwhile we only need 4 slots to handle, thus this 4 options method is 
surprisingly easier to implement.

Thanks,
Qu

> 
>>
>> The number 0 means the newest slot, which should be the same as the one
>> recorded in the super block and no need to load any backup root.
>>
>> 1/2/3 means the second/third/fourth(oldest) backup slot to use.
>>
>> The existing "rescue=usebackuproot" is just an alias of
>> "rescue=usebackuproot_1".
>>
>> This will allow users to choose which backup root to use, thus can have
>> a better control than blindly choose any slot that can pass the very
>> basic root node checks.
>>
>> Signed-off-by: Qu Wenruo <wqu@suse.com>
>

2026-10-01.patch_summary: Proposal to introduce more accurate usebackuproot options in Btrfs, including mirroring compression levels and parsing as rescue=usebackuproot[:N]
